title: Cloaked Slip Drive
flavorText: A quiet drive that slips through half-gated routes.
rulesText: When you Evade, you may spend 1 QP from the pool to automatically succeed. You may evade through half-connected tiles.

title: Gravitic Anchor
flavorText: A mass sink that makes evasion expensive nearby.
rulesText: Any ship in the same sector must pay 2 resources from its pool to use the tactical Evade action.

title: Impulse Thrusters
flavorText: A burst pack for when the lane opens and you need to be first.
rulesText: On your action turn, spend 1 H3 from the pool to add +1 speed until Maintenance begins. Once per round.

title: Magnetic Grapple
flavorText: Magnetic tethers that snag fleeing drives.
rulesText: When an enemy attempts Evade or Retreat in this hex, roll a die. On 5+, cancel the whole attempt.

title: Nano Repair Bots
flavorText: Swarms of miniture mechanics that stitch hull breaches and repair damage.
rulesText: At the start of Maintenance, before enemy combat, remove 1 damage cube from this ship (stacks with other repair effects).

title: Nested Overdrive
flavorText: Stacked drives wound tight for reckless straight-line speed.

title: Self-destruct Protocol
flavorText: A last-resort charge wired to take the hex with you.
rulesText: When this ship is destroyed, roll 4 combat dice at 4+ against each opposing ship in this hex. Chain reactions apply. Defences do not apply. No Spoils of War.

title: Stealth Field
flavorText: A shroud that keeps rivals guessing until you choose to be seen.
rulesText: Rivals cannot start combat against this ship unless they exhaust an Interact token to locate it for that combat.

title: Subspace Relay
flavorText: A fleet-sideband that lets one sister ship trade on your market ping.
rulesText: Once per global round, when this ship uses a Trade action, one other ship in your fleet may also use a Trade action. The bonus trade does not spend a Trade token, but that ship must still be at a valid trade location. Only one other ship per trigger.

title: Warp Drive Mk I
flavorText: A reliable jump drive that keeps your ship ahead in the initiative queue.

title: Temporal Echo
flavorText: A temporal buffer that lets you revisit a dice roll you already committed to.
rulesText: Once per round, after you roll dice for an action, you may reroll all of those dice once.
